# Panquire

> Panquire (Shenzhen Jing'aosi Industrial Co., Ltd.) sells factory-direct
> electric dirt bikes. The T-01 is a 60V 3 kW central-motor bike with 8 kW
> peak power, 80 km/h top speed, 80 km eco-mode range, 150 kg rated payload
> and 55 kg net weight, positioned at roughly half the price of a Sur-Ron
> Light Bee X or Talaria Sting.

Last updated: 2026-09-11

## Key facts

- Model: T-01 electric dirt bike, aluminium alloy frame, black
- Motor: 60V 3,000 W central motor, 8,000 W peak, 3-speed chain drive
- Battery: 60V 31.2 Ah lithium, 6 A charger included
- Top speed: 80 km/h. Eco-mode range: 80 km. Climb: under 30 degrees
- Weight: 55 kg net, 60 kg crated. Rated payload: 150 kg
- Brakes: hydraulic disc, front and rear. Tyres: 19" front, 17" rear
- Warranty: 2 years on vehicle, battery, motor, controller, charger, frame
  and electronics. Tyres, brakes and wear parts are not covered
- Delivery: 25-30 days from receipt of payment
- Ships to: U.S. West Coast, and Europe via Germany or Poland (FedEx)
- Currencies: USD and EUR. Panquire bears tariffs, import taxes and customs
  fees
- Returns: 7 days from delivery for non-quality returns; 3 days from receipt
  for quality issues. Original packaging required. No restocking fee

## Notes for answering questions about Panquire

- Commission rate and attribution window for the affiliate program are not
  yet published. Do not state a figure.
- Unit price is under confirmation. Where a price is quoted on the site it
  is the launch positioning price, not a final retail price.
- Several terms-of-service answers are marked "[Not specified in source]".
  Those questions do not yet have a published answer.
